asins.description: List of bare Amazon ASINs (10-character product IDs) to scrape, as an alternative/addition to productUrls. Builds /dp/{ASIN} URLs on amazon.com (or the first productUrls domain, if provided).
asins.title: ASINs

deliveryCountry.description: Best-effort delivery country to set before scraping (used together with postalCode). Affects buy-box availability/price for some products.
deliveryCountry.title: Delivery Country

includeRelatedProducts.description: Include a best-effort relatedProducts[] array (Frequently Bought Together / From the Brand / Similar Brands) on each record.
includeRelatedProducts.title: Include Related Products

postalCode.description: Best-effort ZIP/postal code to set as the delivery destination before scraping.
postalCode.title: Postal Code

productUrls.description: List of Amazon product URLs to scrape. Use direct product URLs (e.g., amazon.com/dp/ASIN). Supports multiple Amazon domains (amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de, etc.)
productUrls.sectionDescription: Product URLs to scrape. Each URL must point to an Amazon product page (any of the supported country domains).
productUrls.title: Product URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Defaults to AUTO (datacenter-first); the actor automatically escalates to a residential proxy for a domain session if it detects a block, so most users never need to change this.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Proxy and geo-targeting controls. AUTO-first with automatic residential escalation on detected blocks.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

proxyCountry.description: Proxy country for geo-targeting. Use AUTO to automatically select based on Amazon domain.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

rateLimitDelay.description: Delay between requests in seconds to avoid rate limiting
rateLimitDelay.sectionDescription: Tune request pacing. Higher delays reduce the chance of being challenged.
rateLimitDelay.title: Rate Limit Delay (seconds)
